description: Tata Rekavo (which means 'Fire Tracker' in Guarani) is a team from Paraguay focused on developing data and AI solutions for environmental monitoring. Our goal is to harmonize NASA's satellite fire data (MODIS and VIIRS) to create visualization and prediction tools that provide actionable insights for protecting our local ecosystems, such as the Chaco and Pantanal regions, through a scalable model designed to be replicated anywhere in the world.
